title: Felpaw Village
wikitext:
[[Image:Felpaw Village.jpg|thumb|Felpaw Village]]

'''Felpaw Village''' is an encampment that lies in the very north of [[Felwood]] near the entrance of [[Timbermaw Hold]]. The encampment belongs to the [[Deadwood tribe]] of [[corrupted furbolg]]s. Killing the Deadwoods is a good way to gain [[reputation]] with [[Timbermaw Hold]].
